en.titre: niche wellness habits that make you 10x more confident

en.intro: even on days you're _not going anywhere_
paragraphes: a real outfit changes how you _stand, walk and talk_

en.intro: confidence is trust, and trust is _built daily_
paragraphes: say you'll do it, _then do it_. even something tiny
water the plants, read 5 pages, _make your bed_
en.chute: you become someone _you can count on_

en.intro: not for anyone else. _just for you_
paragraphes: 10 minutes where you take care of yourself _on purpose_
candle, music, _no phone_ on the sink

en.intro: finishing a run i planned makes me feel _unstoppable_
paragraphes: i'd plan to run, then not know what to do, and _skip it_ every time
my tip: a running coach app like Atala lays out _your whole week_, so you just show up
you don't owe anyone _a long excuse_
the right song changes _how you walk_ into a room
en.chute: you're the main character, _act like it_
